hero.bodyLeft: Alkindi is a digital product studio that offers a wide variety of services and delivers only the work it is proud of.
hero.bodyRight: We enjoy making complex problems look simple. Bring us yours and we'll make it happen.
services.label: Services
services.lead: Here are the services we offer.
services.01.title: Smart Contract Development
services.01.desc: EVM contracts shipped audit-ready: spec, source, invariant tests, fuzz suite, deploy scripts. Invariants written before the contracts, every state path covered before deploy.
services.02.title: Smart Contract Audits
services.02.desc: EVM contract audits that end in remediation, not just findings. Manual review, fuzzing, invariant testing, economic analysis: each finding root-caused, each fix reviewed.
services.03.title: Technical Advisory
services.03.desc: Architecture reviews, tech decisions, Web3 integration, security posture. Written assessments with a recommendation, including 'don't' when that's the answer.
services.04.title: Brand & Visual Identity
services.04.desc: Brand systems made to be used, not just admired. Naming, marks, type, color, voice: designed as one, built to last.
services.05.title: Copywriting
services.05.desc: Plain words for complex products. Brand voice, landing pages, UI microcopy, long-form: written to land on first read.
services.06.title: Web Design
services.06.desc: Strategy (sitemap, information architecture, content hierarchy), design (layout, type, motion), build (semantic markup, performance, accessibility), ship (deployment, maintenance). One studio, every layer.
services.07.title: Graphics & Digital Art
services.07.desc: Original illustration, motion, and motifs. By hand or by code, never from a stock library.
services.08.title: User Experience Design
services.08.desc: Research (interviews, observation), synthesis (journey maps, problem statements), structure (information architecture, user flows), validation (prototypes, usability testing). The right problem framed, then solved.
services.09.title: User Interface Design
services.09.desc: Interfaces that don't need a guide, a tutorial, or a tooltip. Components, tokens, states, prototypes: drawn and shipped intact.
services.10.title: Web App Development
services.10.desc: Web apps shipped with everything a new team needs to take over: code, docs, tests, deploy pipeline. Smallest codebase that does the job.
services.11.title: Hi-Fi Listening Rooms
services.11.desc: Room layout, gear sourcing and purchasing, system assembly, acoustic measurement, and tuning. One listening room built to measure, not just to look good.
about.label: About al‑Kindi
about.lead: A small, focused studio with roots in software and a strong foundation in design.
about.body1: We prefer clear scope, honest dialogue and work that can stand on its own without big words. Sometimes that means adding a feature; sometimes it means simplifying and removing noise.
about.body2: We're not chasing trends. We're here to help you build something useful, consistent and well‑made.
origin.label: Origin
origin.body1: al‑Kindi, the 9th‑century Baghdadi polymath, wrote on philosophy, music, optics. And invented cryptanalysis. The frequency analysis he laid out in Baghdad broke every cipher humanity had built; no system resistant to it would emerge for seven centuries. The same hand tuned an oud, translated Aristotle, and read enciphered letters.
origin.body2: The same 'al‑' is everywhere in Portugal, where we work: Alfama, Algarve, Alentejo, Almada. Quiet traces of the Arabic‑speaking world he came from.
origin.body3: Eleven centuries later, his work on ciphers is the foundation of every smart contract we deploy. We borrowed the name in tribute.
team.label: Team
team.munevver.name: Münevver Aslan
team.munevver.bio: Münevver brings a multidisciplinary eye to every project, spanning brand systems, interaction design and the fine line between clarity and character. Born in Istanbul, now based between Lisbon and wherever the work takes her.
team.partner.name: Ferit Tunçer
team.partner.bio: The engineering half of al‑Kindi and founder of the studio. Ten years building production software with deep focus on Ethereum: smart contract development, security review, and gas‑sensitive protocol work. Cypherpunk by orientation, computer science by training. Based in Lisbon.
contact.label: Contact
contact.heading: Have a product to launch, a brand to refine or a service that needs better structure?
contact.sub: Tell us where you are and where you want to go. We'll help you design the path.
